description: Add an edit button that appears when hovering over columns in the schema visualizer. When clicked, this button should open the column edit pane on the right side of the screen, allowing users to edit columns directly from the visualizer interface rather than navigating through multiple menus.
functional_requirements: Show an edit button on the right side of a column when the user hovers over it in the schema visualizer
Clicking the edit button should open the existing column edit pane on the right side of the screen
The column edit pane should be pre-populated with the selected column's current configuration
Maintain all existing column editing functionality through this new access point
Ensure the hover state and button appearance provide clear visual feedback to users
